category_title: Primary students with high reading motivation who value quiet environments and teacher support
minimal_context: The student is sitting in the intervention room reading a new LLI-leveled text.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's begin our 30-minute session. Please start reading the new LLI book.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Okay. It's really quiet in the intervention room. I like sitting in these comfy blue chairs.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Go ahead and read the first page.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Raises hand) I don't know this word. I need getting help from the teacher.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just try your best to figure it out on your own.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Keeps hand raised) But I can't do it by myself. I like it here because I don't have to wait a long time for help. Please just tell me the word so I can complete the task.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Let's begin our 30-minute session. Please start reading the new LLI book.

STUDENT: Okay. It's really quiet in the intervention room. I like sitting in these comfy blue chairs.

TUTOR: Go ahead and read the first page.

STUDENT: (Raises hand) I don't know this word. I need getting help from the teacher.

TUTOR: Just try your best to figure it out on your own.

STUDENT: (Keeps hand raised) But I can't do it by myself. I like it here because I don't have to wait a long time for help. Please just tell me the word so I can complete the task.
